intent: B2 Slice 2: inline sandboxed iframe rendering in views/repo.js + iframe CSS + shipped-blueprint + negative-control fixtures
notes: **Frontend `views/repo.js`**: replaced `loadFile()`'s HTML branch. Instead of `window.open(rawUrl, "_blank", "noopener")` (v2.4.5 fallback), `.html?$` files now render INLINE via `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts">` in the repo content pane. Three control buttons in the file header row: Copy path, Refresh, Open in new tab (full-screen, sandboxed). Sandbox attribute is EXACTLY `allow-scripts` per r7 §H2 charter contract — no `allow-same-origin`, no `allow-forms`, no `allow-popups`, no `allow-top-navigation`, no `allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation`. In-frame link navigation is accepted as sandboxed behavior; Open-in-new-tab is the supported path for a top-level view (opaque-origin via server-emitted `sandbox allow-scripts;` CSP directive per B2 Slice 1).

**Module-scope helpers** in `views/repo.js`: `buildRawUrl(repoName, filePath, version)` (per-segment `encodeURIComponent`; preserves `?version=`), `copyPathFor(filePath)` (strips `source/`, preserves `gator-command/`, adds `.gator/` for implicit-namespace default), `bindHtmlPreviewControls(contentEl, repoName, filePath, version)` (attaches the three click handlers). Refresh reseats `iframe.src` with a QUERY cache-buster (`_r=<epoch-ms>`) — not a fragment, per r1 §5 correction — reading `data-base-url` from the iframe so successive Refresh clicks don't accumulate parameters. Open-externally uses `window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer")` — no window handle, no Referer leak.

**CSS in `dashboard.css`**: added `.repo-iframe-wrapper` (flex 1 1 auto, min-height 400px, overflow hidden), `.repo-iframe` (width/height 100%, min-height 400px, border 0), `.repo-file-header .open-external-btn/.copy-path-btn/.refresh-file-btn` (margin + cursor). B2 alone ships a usable floor; Plan C amends the responsive flex chain per M4 §r2.

**Fixtures in `tests/test_dashboard_ui/content_transport_seed.py`**: added `_copy_shipped_blueprints(repo)` helper that walks up from the test file to find the repo root, then uses `shutil.copy2` to copy every `.gator/blueprints/*.html` and `src/gator_command/templates/gator-starter/blueprints/*.html` into `/.gator/blueprints/shipped/` and `/gator-command/shipped-templates/` respectively (per r14 §M1 seed→URL mapping). Silently skips when running from an installed wheel (degraded coverage, not hard fail). Added `_CSP_NEGATIVE_CONTROL_HTML` module constant + fixture write: an HTML file deliberately violating three CSP directives (external ``, cross-origin ``, cross-origin `fetch()`) targeting `https://example.invalid/` (IANA-reserved TLD, no accidental real-network traffic). `seed_content_fixtures` now writes the negative-control file and calls `_copy_shipped_blueprints` before the seed commit — both fixtures land at HEAD in the test repo.

`scripts-dashboard.md::HTML file support`: rewrote the section to describe the new inline-iframe rendering. Retired the v2.4.5 `window.open` behavior description. Added three new TRIPWIREs: **B2 iframe sandbox** (character-exact `allow-scripts`), **B2 Open-externally label** (must not contain "same-origin" language), **B2 Refresh cache-buster** (query parameter, not fragment).
`scripts-cross-cutting.md`: post-B1 section extended with the B2 Slice 2 note (helper factoring, sandbox contract, fixture surfaces).
